description_full:
We are opening internship slots for the following positions:
* Social Media Marketing Intern 📱
* 2D Artist Intern 🎨

Requirements:
* Fluent written and verbal English
* Know anime and game culture
* Proficient in video editing software
* Self-disciplined and have good time management skills
* Minimum 3 months
* Based in Indonesia

Bonus points if you:
* Have played our visual novels before
* Are chronically online
* Like otome games

Benefits:
* Paid internship
* Receive a referral letter at the end of your internship
* Work with a small, close-knit team

🗓 Deadline: 30 November 2026

📧 Interested? Send your CV to our email!

Please note that we will only contact those who have passed the selection round.

Looking forward to work with you!
